name: ModulusTools SEO Suite (`modulustools-seo-suite`)
author: themrsami

sections.description:
Modular Technical SEO, Semantic Content Analyzer, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) plugin for WordPress.

Architecture Overview

  • modulustools-seo-suite.php — Main plugin bootstrap and header declarations
  • uninstall.php — Opt-in cleanup of custom database tables and options
  • includes/class-autoloader.php — PSR-4 autoloader for ModulusTools\SEO\*
  • includes/class-activator.php — dbDelta() custom table creation and default settings
  • includes/class-deactivator.php — Transient and rewrite rule cleanup
  • includes/class-core.php — Module controller, Admin Dashboard, Bulk Editor, Site Audit, and Metabox UI
  • includes/api/class-rest-controller.php — Authenticated REST endpoints (/wp-json/modulustools-seo/v1/*)
  • includes/modules/ — Modular feature classes (Frontend_Head, Schema_Graph, Sitemaps, Redirects_404, GEO_LLMs, AI_BYOK, Image_SEO, Link_Assistant, Migrator)
  • assets/css/ — admin-style.css and sitemap-style.css
  • assets/js/ — admin-app.js
